title: GAP Waiver Addenda Refund Schedule: Free-Look Period, Cancellation Fee and Earned Charge
content:
**Refund schedule: GAP Waiver Addenda.** The schedule sets the refund terms for each plan.

| Plan | Free-look period after the contract date | Cancellation fee outside the free-look period (USD) | Fee waived when the addendum cancels on early payoff |
|---|---|---|---|
| GAP Waiver 120 | 30 calendar days | 75.00 | no |
| GAP Waiver 130 | 30 calendar days | 75.00 | no |
| GAP Waiver 140 | 30 calendar days | 50.00 | no |
| GAP Waiver 150 | 30 calendar days | 50.00 | no |
| GAP Waiver Plus 150 | 60 calendar days | 50.00 | yes |
| GAP Waiver Premier 150 | 60 calendar days | 25.00 | yes |

**Terms common to every plan**

- *Free look.* A voluntary cancellation within the free-look period after the contract date receives a full refund with no fee.
- *Refund method outside the free-look period.* The unearned charge is computed pro rata by days. The unearned share is the calendar days from the cancellation effective date to the expiration date, divided by the calendar days from the enrollment date to the expiration date.
- *Smallest refund.* A computed refund below 10.00 is not issued.
- *Where a refund goes.* A refund goes to the first applicable destination in this order: credited to the contract balance; credited to the deficiency balance; mailed to the borrower.
- *Earned in full.* An addendum that paid a benefit is fully earned, and so is an addendum that reaches its expiration date.

*Hypothetical reading.* Take an addendum enrolled 1826 days before its expiration date, cancelled with 1100 days to run. Its unearned share is 1100 divided by 1826.
